overall_summary: Hosted read-only verification ran in a real Chromium browser and against the BFF. The Management outliers (attribution tab) and shadow tabs and their crawl routes render honest empty/prompt states with 0 page errors; Agora system suggestions return hosted institutional facts via the BFF. The natural events required by AC1-AC4 (a Trading Room decision lock, Agora platform-source records, a weekly-run attribution record, an MT-4 review) do not exist on hosted dev and were NOT synthesised. The full Management crawl did NOT pass in either of two runs (see crawl).

AC1_decision_lock_and_settlement_source.observed: GET /bff/agora/trading-room/decision-events -> 200, items=[], page_size 0 (sha256 1df93f21...). No event id exists, so no decision-lock, no arms/unavailable_arms reason and no settlement source label could be read. GET /bff/management/attribution/shadow/{id} not callable without an id.
AC1_decision_lock_and_settlement_source.reason: No real Agora Trading Room decision exists that is visible to the operator principal. The Trading Room page itself reports 'decision events: unavailable (0) upstream_unavailable' and 'No StrategySpec workspace is currently available'. Visibility is principal-scoped, so decisions owned by an Agora trader identity the probe does not hold cannot be excluded.
AC1_decision_lock_and_settlement_source.needed: A real human Trading Room decision on hosted dev (Agora trader), then re-read decision-lock and Management shadow for that decision id.

AC3_weekly_outlier_attribution.observed: GET /bff/management/attribution/records and /outliers -> 200 status empty, owner attribution, meta.status ok, items 0 (sha256 85327d2d...). Owner reachable and returning an honest empty set; no decomposition or luck interval exists to inspect.
AC3_weekly_outlier_attribution.reason_known: The weekly outlier run is requested by the MT-3 first-enrolled-persona trigger. Both hosted MT-3 meetings (mtg-492d824b116f9ace 2026-W47, mtg-fd08f490b178e756 2026-W48) were refused with outcome insufficient_participants. The Management Performance attribution tab for the period shows 'no outlier records for this period'. Whether a run was requested at all and what the owner computed is not exposed by any BFF read; the persona detail snapshots (3 enrolled personas) carry no weekly_outlier_run / not_fired fields.
AC3_weekly_outlier_attribution.reason_unknown: Whether /api/attribution/runs was ever called, and its result, could not be read without owner/DB access.

AC4_MT4_review_and_research_demands.observed: GET /bff/management/meetings (20 total, window 2026-11-18..2026-11-25): MT-1 14 (9 closed, 4 refused, 1 convened), MT-2 4 closed, MT-3 2 refused; zero MT-4 and none carries attribution_record_id. Catalogue lists MT-4 performance_attribution_review as enabled (cadence weekly_and_event). Research demands: 2 open demands (rd-975bb89106f1c696a680, rd-796e24e24bf2055d3c42) with mandate meeting_research_demand created 2026-11-22/24 from earlier meetings, not from MT-4.
AC4_MT4_review_and_research_demands.reason: MT-4 is opened per attribution record; there are 0 attribution records, so the trigger had nothing to fire on (design: not_fired reason no_new_attribution_record). no_testable_hypothesis could not be recorded by a review because no review ran.
AC4_MT4_review_and_research_demands.needed: An attribution record from AC3, then MT-4 and its red-team hypotheses routed to research demands.
